title: Ultrasound Guided Peripheral Intravenous Catheter Insertion in the Hospitalized Patient: Long vs. Short Axis Placement
brief_summary: Comparison of peripheral IV catheters inserted by ultrasound using the long axis vs. the short axis technique. Our hypothesis is that long axis ultrasound placement will increase the longevity of the IV catheter.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* A patient who needs PIV access for intravenous medications and resuscitation either on a medical-surgical floor or in the ICU
* After floor team (including RN and/or house staff) and IV Nurse have attempted and failed or is not available

Exclusion Criteria:

* Need for vasopressors
* Need for TPN
* Need for hemodynamic monitoring
* Non English speaking patient
* Patients who are unable to consent
